problems.title: Problem 1: Constant of Proportionality
problems.prompt: A vehicle travels at a constant speed, covering $150$ miles in $2.5$ hours. Determine the unit rate $k = \frac{y}{x}$ in miles per hour, write the equation representing the relationship, and calculate how far the car travels in $4$ hours.
problems.problem: A vehicle travels at a constant speed, covering $150$ miles in $2.5$ hours. Determine the unit rate $k = \frac{y}{x}$ in miles per hour, write the equation representing the relationship, and calculate how far the car travels in $4$ hours.
problems.hint: Divide distance by time to identify the constant of proportionality $k$. Then use $y = kx$.
problems.solution: $k = \frac{150}{2.5} = 60\text{ mph}$. The equation is $y = 60x$. For $x = 4$, $y = 60(4) = 240\text{ miles}$.

problems.title: Problem 2: Ratio of Fractions
problems.prompt: Jackson cleans $\frac{3}{8}$ of a playground in $\frac{1}{4}$ of an hour. At this constant rate, how many playgrounds can Jackson clean in $1$ full hour?
problems.problem: Jackson cleans $\frac{3}{8}$ of a playground in $\frac{1}{4}$ of an hour. At this constant rate, how many playgrounds can Jackson clean in $1$ full hour?
problems.hint: Divide the fractional amount cleaned by the fractional time elapsed: $\frac{3/8}{1/4}$.
problems.solution: $\text{Unit Rate} = \frac{3}{8} \div \frac{1}{4} = \frac{3}{8} \times \frac{4}{1} = \frac{12}{8} = 1\frac{1}{2}\text{ playgrounds per hour}$.

problems.title: Problem 3: Scale Drawing Computation
problems.prompt: On a blueprint, a rectangular courtyard has dimensions $4.5\text{ cm}$ by $8\text{ cm}$. The drawing scale is $1\text{ cm} : 5\text{ m}$. Calculate the actual perimeter and actual area of the courtyard in meters.
problems.problem: On a blueprint, a rectangular courtyard has dimensions $4.5\text{ cm}$ by $8\text{ cm}$. The drawing scale is $1\text{ cm} : 5\text{ m}$. Calculate the actual perimeter and actual area of the courtyard in meters.
problems.hint: Multiply each blueprint dimension by the scale factor $5$ to find actual length and width.
problems.solution: $\text{Actual width} = 4.5 \times 5 = 22.5\text{ m}$. $\text{Actual length} = 8 \times 5 = 40\text{ m}$. $\text{Perimeter} = 2(22.5 + 40) = 125\text{ m}$. $\text{Area} = 22.5 \times 40 = 900\text{ m}^2$.

problems.hint: Divide the fractional amount cleaned by the fractional time elapsed: $\frac{3/8}{1/4}$.
problems.solution: $\text{Unit Rate} = \frac{3}{8} \div \frac{1}{4} = \frac{3}{8} \times \frac{4}{1} = \frac{12}{8} = 1\frac{1}{2}\text{ playgrounds per hour}$.

problems.title: Problem 3: Scale Drawing Computation
problems.prompt: On a blueprint, a rectangular courtyard has dimensions $4.5\text{ cm}$ by $8\text{ cm}$. The drawing scale is $1\text{ cm} : 5\text{ m}$. Calculate the actual perimeter and actual area of the courtyard in meters.
problems.problem: On a blueprint, a rectangular courtyard has dimensions $4.5\text{ cm}$ by $8\text{ cm}$. The drawing scale is $1\text{ cm} : 5\text{ m}$. Calculate the actual perimeter and actual area of the courtyard in meters.
problems.hint: Multiply each blueprint dimension by the scale factor $5$ to find actual length and width.
problems.solution: $\text{Actual width} = 4.5 \times 5 = 22.5\text{ m}$. $\text{Actual length} = 8 \times 5 = 40\text{ m}$. $\text{Perimeter} = 2(22.5 + 40) = 125\text{ m}$. $\text{Area} = 22.5 \times 40 = 900\text{ m}^2$.
